#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Convert documented fixed-width warehouse records to CSV."""

import csv
import os
import re
import sys

RECORD_WIDTH = 21
ID_END = 5
NAME_END = 17
QUANTITY_RE = re.compile(r"^[0-9]{4}$")


def main():
    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
        sys.stderr.write("usage: import.py INPUT\n")
        return 2

    input_path = sys.argv[1]
    rejects_path = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(input_path)), "rejects.txt")
    writer = csv.writer(sys.stdout, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(("id", "name", "quantity"))

    with open(input_path, "r", encoding="ascii", newline="") as source, open(
        rejects_path, "w", encoding="ascii", newline=""
    ) as rejects:
        for line_number, raw_line in enumerate(source, 1):
            record = raw_line[:-1] if raw_line.endswith("\n") else raw_line
            quantity = record[NAME_END:] if len(record) == RECORD_WIDTH else ""
            if len(record) != RECORD_WIDTH or not QUANTITY_RE.match(quantity):
                rejects.write("{}: {}\n".format(line_number, record))
                continue

            record_id = record[:ID_END]
            name = record[ID_END:NAME_END].rstrip(" ")
            writer.writerow((record_id, name, quantity))

    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
